sm_top.sm: Houthi missile and drone attacks on Riyadh airport resulted in 13 deaths and 17 injuries.
The IDF sealed off the homes of attackers involved in a fatal Hebron incident.
The Houthis claimed responsibility for attacks on East-West oil pumping stations in Saudi Arabia, though there was no immediate Saudi confirmation.
Saudi Arabia partly reopened Riyadh Airport despite Houthi missile and drone threats.
Yemen's Houthis claimed they targeted Riyadh airport and a Saudi oil pipeline.
Romania blamed Russia after a drone strike sank a cargo ship in the Black Sea, killing a sailor and leaving three missing.
Jordanian security forces arrested three suspects following a deadly church shooting attack.
An IRGC official warned that Iran would target undersea internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz if its infrastructure is attacked.
An oil tanker was disabled in the Strait of Hormuz.
A suspected Houthi missile landed near a military headquarters in Aden, causing explosions.
The Saudi-led coalition stated it destroyed Houthi missile facilities in Yemen.
A drone attack in Russia's Voronezh region killed two people.
An oil spill from a tanker forced the closure of beaches in Umm Al Quwain.
The Saudi-led coalition stated it struck Houthi missile facilities following an attack on Riyadh.
Iran claimed it shot down a U.S. LUCAS attack drone operating near the Strait of Hormuz.
UK and French troops conducted joint military exercises simulating attacks on NATO.
US forces prepared to launch major operations against Iran within 96 hours of an order.
US Central Command reported an Iran attack plan to the defense secretary.
Rapid Support Forces drones struck five power stations in Sudan, causing mass power outages.
The death toll from an attack in Taraba reached 58.
A drone attack on the Tolyattikauchuk petrochemical plant in Tolyatti damaged production facilities.
US intelligence indicates Iran is in advanced stages of planning attacks against US targets in the region.
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted missiles and drones in an overnight attack.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen resulted in more than 10 deaths.
Russian attacks injured people and damaged buildings in Zaporizhzhia.
The Israeli military conducted a large-scale operation in the West Bank.
The Malian military updated the death toll from a recent attack to 54.
A drone attack injured five people and damaged an industrial facility in Russia's Perm region.
A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Omsk Region injured three people, according to the governor.
Russian attacks in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast killed 3 people.
Iranian officials claimed the Strait of Hormuz is closed and reported tankers struck.
The UN reports that drone strikes have killed at least 306 people in Sudan.
Ansarallah launched missile and drone strikes hitting a camp in Shabwa, resulting in dozens of fatalities among security personnel.
The injury toll from a Russian attack on Vinnytsia rose to seven as search and rescue operations concluded.
Attacks on Christians in Ethiopia's Oromia region killed dozens of people.
The death toll from a Russian drone strike on a park in Kharkiv Oblast rose to six.
Over 570 merchant vessels have been attacked and 40 seafarers killed in the Black Sea this year.
Russian forces attacked an energy facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, causing power cuts.
Russian air defense forces report destroying 290 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
A Houthi missile strike hits a gathering of Saudi-led troops, leaving dozens dead.
